title: Correctness: GEN_IV missing finalized/error guard
description: Trigger: call CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_INIT, then CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE, then CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_GEN_IV. ioctl_gen_iv (fd.c ~line 789) checks fd_type but does NOT check state->finalized or state->error, unlike ioctl_set_iv which checks both at line 746. Bad outcome: (1) GEN_IV on a finalized session calls ops->set_iv() on a provider context that has already been through finalize(); provider behavior is undefined on a finalized context. (2) GEN_IV on an error session calls into a potentially corrupt wolfCrypt context; ops->set_iv() may crash or produce garbage. In both cases state->iv_set is set to true, corrupting observable state. Fix: add the same finalized/error guard present in ioctl_set_iv.
